correctness.rationale: The ordered seven-vertex complex is the d=2 case of the closed combinatorial manifold theorem, and the earlier connectivity/homology theorem gives simple connectivity and integral middle rank 40. I independently triangulated the product cells by monotone staircases. Replay: python3 /workspace/evidence/deleted_product_staircases.py. It produces simplex counts (42,420,1680,2100,840), verifies the signed simplicial fundamental cycle and the reversing coordinate swap, and checks ordinary simplicial Alexander–Whitney self-cups on all 419 basis cocycles of the kernel of the degree-two coboundary, with coboundary rank 379. Thus all mod-two self-cups vanish, and Wu and Poincaré duality give w2=0 and evenness. The signed swap gives signature zero; integral Poincaré duality, even indefinite unimodular lattice classification and Freedman's theorem (the combinatorial structure gives Kirby–Siebenmann invariant zero) then give exactly the stated TOP type. In the supplied checker line 147 uses (-1)^(3+i) rather than (-1)^(2+i); this flips the entire (3,2) cardinality sector of the boundary rows and does not change the zero test, since first-factor faces land in the disjoint (2,3) sector. The independent simplicial computation uses actual simplicial boundary signs. No PL or smooth classification follows.
